description.value:
You stoke the fires of the people to take down those that abuse their position of leadership. Select a creature within 60 feet that has other creatures obeying it, and make a Society check against the creature's Will DC: @Check[society|defense:will].

Critical Success You shake the confidence of the creature's minions. They take a -2 circumstance penalty to their attack rolls for 1 minute. Once the creature is slain, these minions might be willing to end combat early if you have not harmed them. (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.effects.Item.gPIKNapZQVzwLH8m])

Success As critical success, but the penalty is -1. (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.effects.Item.6li58MAdwtzm6okr])

Critical Failure You ignite the fury of the creature's minions. They gain a +2 circumstance bonus to their next attack roll against you within 1 minute.
